description: Issue #148: the guard is about SCOPE and nothing else. #201 fails the same lint gate with the same log on every turn — the identical shape the scope case stops on — and is still driven to the --max-turns 3 cap (3 sends), because a lint failure is inside the worktree and one more turn really can fix it. scope.allow is the one gate a worker cannot satisfy from where it stands; generalising the guard to every gate would turn the runner into something that gives up on ordinary work.

summary_includes: verification 失敗の worktree を診断し
